name: dsfd_su_t_pin_rt-rt3-6d627c6fe
purpose: SU pin owner rt2, pin-register defect (pinreg audit 10-13: clk->pin 376.5 ps on dn_d, pin->flop 348 ps on up_d against 166.7 ps): the RTL is two registers pin to pin (pin flop, output flop); rt's placer put both mid-tile (572.4 um wide, W <-> E). Kit recipe 2: pin flops and hold stages FIRM at the pins, hold 30 ps. Same RTL, outline, pins, cycles (rt CLOSED TT +132.69 / FF +20.92) | rt3: rt2 (recipe 2, pin flops at the pins) routed TT -10.55 / FF +28.02 / DRC 0: the miss is c_rf[63] flop -> c_rf port over 213 ps of wire + the output hold stage, because synthesis had merged the c_rf / dn_d (and dn_v / c_rv, wq_v / c_uv) twin registers into one flop serving two faces; RTL: the twins are keep registers, one flop a pin.
